WITH project_counts AS (
  SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) as qc_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(qc_count) as total_qc, COUNT(*) as num_projects FROM project_counts
)
SELECT 
  pc.arcref,
  pc.qc_count,
  CAST(pc.qc_count AS REAL) / t.total_qc as share,
  (CAST(pc.qc_count AS REAL) / t.total_qc) - (1.0 / t.num_projects) as deviation
FROM project_counts pc
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY deviation DESC
LIMIT 10
